meta.league: Phase 0 public Fleaflicker test league (12-team keeper league: IDP, punters, targets instead of catches, 82 rules incl. length bands)
meta.source: Fleaflicker box-score points (FetchLeagueBoxscore viewingActualPoints) vs Sleeper's weekly actual stats × the scoring map; players joined through Sportradar ids
meta.selection: every rule type the oracle counts as tested and per-game rules on players who didn't play (up to 15 player-weeks each), then 30% of each position-and-week stratum of players who played and 10% of those who didn't, in a fixed hash order; chosen without looking at whether a case matches
